reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already encodes the missing/number/range (furthest-from-zero) rule used by the server's posting and preview paths.

duplication.why: No amount logic is written in the diff; it is a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal and APIScheduleEntity in server/api-models.ts, where the API's external schedule shape is defined.

scope.why: One type field, one mapped field and a small focused test file.

maintainability.why: A future change to the expected-amount rule in getScheduledAmount reaches the API automatically; the field is documented as read-only.
